CNG prices increased in several cities. Sounak Mukhopadhyay Published 1 Nov 2026, 07:16 AM IST Prefer Livemint on Google Petrol and diesel prices today, November 1: Check fuel rates in different cities across India REUTERS/Stephanie Lecocq ( REUTERS/Stephanie Lecocq ) AI Quick Read Fuel prices across Indian cities remained largely unchanged today, with some local increases and cuts. Petrol and diesel became cheaper in Bengaluru and Noida. However, both fuels became costlier in Bhubaneswar and Patna. CNG prices rose in several cities, including Bengaluru, Meerut and Sonipat. In New Delhi, petrol stood at ₹ 102.12 while diesel remained at ₹ 95.20. Kolkata recorded petrol at ₹ 113.51 and diesel at ₹ 99.82. Mumbai's petrol price was ₹ 111.21, with diesel at ₹ 97.83. Chennai recorded petrol at ₹ 107.76 and diesel at ₹ 99.55. All four cities reported no change in either fuel. Also Read | Govt removes export duty on petrol, raises diesel and ATF levies: What changed? Gurugram also reported steady prices, with petrol at ₹ 102.97 and diesel at ₹ 95.64. In Noida, petrol fell by seven paise to ₹ 101.89. Diesel also dropped by seven paise, reaching ₹ 95.37. Lucknow's petrol price matched Noida's at ₹ 101.89 while diesel stood at ₹ 95.36. Both fuel prices remained unchanged in Lucknow. Bengaluru recorded a bigger fall in petrol and diesel prices. Petrol dropped by 75 paise to ₹ 110.93. Diesel fell by 76 paise to ₹ 98.80. Meanwhile, Bhubaneswar recorded increases in both fuels. Petrol rose by ₹ 1.52 to ₹ 110.49 while diesel increased by ₹ 1.47 to ₹ 102.15. Petrol in Patna rose by 36 paise to ₹ 113.73. Its diesel price increased by 35 paise to ₹ 99.71. Chandigarh recorded petrol at ₹ 101.54 and diesel at ₹ 89.47, with neither price changing. These were the lowest petrol and diesel prices among the major cities. Hyderabad's petrol remained at ₹ 116.15, the highest among the same cities. Its diesel price stayed at ₹ 104.23. Also Read | Paying extra to buy EV over petrol car? OpEx advantage may shock you Thiruvananthapuram recorded petrol at ₹ 115.49 and diesel at ₹ 104.40. Its diesel price was the highest among these cities, with both fuels unchanged. The petrol price gap between Hyderabad and Chandigarh stood at ₹ 14.61. Their diesel prices differed by ₹ 14.76, with Hyderabad recording the higher figure. Jaipur's petrol and diesel prices also remained steady. Petrol stood at ₹ 113.19 while diesel cost ₹ 98.25. CNG prices today CNG prices presented a different picture in Bengaluru. Its CNG price rose by ₹ 1 to ₹ 99. Bharatpur and Dewas also recorded a ₹ 1 increase, bringing prices to ₹ 99 each. Meerut's CNG rose by ₹ 1 to ₹ 96.50. Sonipat recorded the same increase, reaching ₹ 96. Also Read | Land Rover Defender 110 price drops by ₹34 lakh after local assembly in India Firozabad's CNG price increased by 40 paise to ₹ 99.90. New Delhi and NCR remained unchanged at ₹ 86.98 each. Chennai's CNG held steady at ₹ 99.50 while Rewari remained at ₹ 91.59. Mathura recorded an unchanged price of ₹ 102. Among major cities, Mathura had the highest price. New Delhi and NCR shared the lowest price. Disclosure: All prices are taken from Goodreturns.
